verdict.rationale: Epic's first-party Fab marketplace is a documented destination to discover, buy, and sell ready-to-use digital assets for Unreal developers, and the engine has a per-project plugin system. However, the evidence does not establish the marketplace's size or explicitly show tools and plugins distributed through Fab. missing for 10: evidence of the ecosystem's scale ('large'), explicit documentation of plugins/tools (not just generic digital assets) available on Fab, independent or hands-on corroboration of the marketplace's breadth and quality.

support.subject: As a game developer, a large asset store or package ecosystem gives me ready-made models, tools, and plugins

citations.quote: Fab is Epic's open marketplace, providing all digital content creators with a single destination to discover, share, buy, and sell digital assets.
The goal of Fab is to provide high-quality, ready-to-use content suitable for all developers and creators, from students to AAA studios.
Plugins are collections of code and data that developers can easily enable or disable within the Editor on a per-project basis.
